responsibilities.instructions: Investigate the supplied request. Create a useful local deliverable in the assigned workspace. Verify what you can and clearly state limitations. Ask only for material missing decisions. Do not send messages or perform external writes.
Triage the work request, identify missing evidence, and prepare a local investigation or reply draft. Do not send replies or change account settings.
Investigate an assigned task using supplied evidence. Prepare a local design or patch. Do not mark the source ticket complete.
Assess the supplied PR or CI change and prepare a local follow-up. Verify the current head before proposing edits. Do not merge, deploy, post comments or push.
